documents.text: Ledger-RAG stores source evidence as replayable ledger spans with stable identifiers and hashes. The ledger links atomic claims to cited spans.
The verifier labels claims as support, refute, or insufficient by comparing each claim with cited spans.
The offline pilot reports p50 latency, p95 latency, cost per query, index size, and ledger size as system metrics.
A blue notebook was placed beside the research workstation. This distractor note is unrelated to Ledger-RAG evidence tracking.
Gate 7 uses synthetic fixtures only and does not download external datasets or call model APIs.
